title: Completed comparison at one fixed base
statement: Let P be a base as in [def-per-lisse-completed-system-data]. Given an integral continuous-coefficient reduction datum c and a coefficient isomorphism e from continuous integral coefficients to the completed ring whose residue projections are the reductions of c, there exists Comparison d over P having integralComparison exactly c and coefficientIso exactly e. In particular reduction to normalized finite-free etale systems is an equivalence with its actual quotient and limit maps, and raw rational realization is fully faithful with its specified pure-tensor formula. This is a pointwise assertion; it asserts no scheme-pullback or coefficient-extension operations.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1) and (4), with Corollary 5.1.5 for classical finite local systems; the comparison maps are reduction, inverse limit and localization. Their pullback and coefficient-extension compatibilities use these same maps. Etale-local existence of lattices is cited separately as an existing DAG node.

proof.text: Transport finite locally free modules across the supplied coefficient isomorphism using restriction of scalars, its inverse, and transported finite free local bases. Compose this equivalence with the supplied reduction equivalence c and the normalized tower site comparison.

Whisker the reduction cones by the module-to-abelian forgetful functor and postcompose by the diagram comparison. Transport cokernel and limit universal properties. Naturality, scalar compatibility and the unit/counit projection equations follow by the corresponding equations of c and the equivalence triangle identities. These are the proved private coefficient and integralComparisonOfTower constructions.

Compare ordinary scalar extension with the ringed-site pullback along the identity site functor by uniqueness of left adjoints. The finite-locally-free pullback theorem proves that each rationalized lattice is locally free. Apply completed-lisse-rational-hom. Its unique additive maps define rational realization on morphisms. Tensor induction, the pure-tensor composition formula and scalar naturality prove functoriality. The bijections on Hom give FullyFaithful. The coefficient datum and coefficient isomorphism are retained definitionally.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4): explicit Lean assembly from normalized tower comparison and rational Hom localization.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_pointwise_comparison (P : Base.{u} l)
    (c : IntegralLisseReductionEquivalence l P.E P.X)
    (e : lisseIntegerSheafSized l P.E P.X ≅ completedRing l P)
    (he : ∀ n : ℕ, e.hom ≫ limit.π _ (op n) = integralLisseReduction l P.E P.X n ≫
      (c.finiteConstant n).inv) :
    ∃ d : Comparison l P, d.integralComparison = c ∧ d.coefficientIso = e
